note: Gate commit for the tied-embedding gradient fix. The 600 MB pass is disabled here on purpose: this push must first prove that the corrected backward pass compiles and that the contract package (whole-matrix finite-difference sweep, plan counters, reset freshness, full ring buffer) is green. The moment tests are green the configuration is flipped back to enabled=true in its own commit, and that pass is the one whose numbers are recorded. Any 225-minute pass requested before this fix trained an output head whose gradient covered only the column of the token being read (docs/PROMPT_RESPONSE_PRETRAINING.md section 8.10), so those runs are cancelled rather than reported.
purpose: Compile and contract gate for the corrected tied-embedding gradient; the 600 MB measurement runs in the follow-up commit with enabled=true
